Quality Spell Focus Mastery +1: +1 Quality bonus to the DC of all spells.
Mystic Diversion +9%: +9% Enhancement bonus to decreased threat generated from spell damage.
Insightful Spell Penetration +2: Passive: +2 Insight bonus to Spell Penetration checks.
